test_title: SSC Stenographer 2025 Official Paper (Held On: 07 Aug, 2025 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
Select the option that expresses the given sentence in Direct to Indirect Speech.

She said, "I need some rest."

options.text: She said that she needed some rest.
She said that she needs some rest.
She said that she had needed some rest.
She said that she will need some rest.

solution:
The correct answer is **Option 1**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Indirect Speech:** She said that she needed some rest.
 
• **Key Conversions:**
 
 
• **"I need some rest" becomes "she needed some rest"**
 
 
• The first-person pronoun "I" is changed to "she" to match the reporting subject.
 
• The present tense verb "need" is changed to the past tense "needed" in accordance with the rules of indirect speech.
 
 
 
 
 
• **Reporting verb:**
 
 
• The reporting verb "said" remains unchanged as it is a neutral verb.
 
 
 
• **Punctuation and Format:**
 
 
• In indirect speech, quotation marks are removed.
 
• The sentence is introduced with "that" after the reporting verb.
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 1**.

 

**Correct Sentence:** *"She said that she needed some rest."*

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 2:** "She said that she needs some rest."

 
 
• Incorrect because the present tense "needs" is used instead of changing it to past tense "needed" as per the rules of indirect speech.
 
 
 
• **Option 3:** "She said that she had needed some rest."
 
 
• Incorrect because the past perfect tense "had needed" changes the meaning and is unnecessary here.
 
 
 
• **Option 4:** "She said that she will need some rest."
 
 
• Incorrect because the future tense "will need" is used, which does not align with the original sentence in the present tense.
